b'# Project README

## Command Line Interface Options

The following command line options are available for the CLI:

### Positional Arguments
- `url`: what to download

### Optional Arguments
- `-o`, `--output`: file to write (default: stdout)
- `-q`, `--quiet`: no progress output

## Description

This project provides a simple command line tool to download content from URLs.
